title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 34
description: Ten questions on Genesis 34: Dinah, Shechem and Hamor, the demand for circumcision and the attack by Simeon and Levi.

questions.explanation: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, went out to see the daughters of the land.

answers.text: To draw water at the well
To see the daughters of the land
To keep her father's sheep
To find her brothers in the field

questions.explanation: Shechem was the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land.

answers.text: Hamor the Hivite
Laban the Syrian
Abimelech of Gerar
Ephron the Hittite

questions.text: What did Jacob do when he heard that Dinah had been defiled?
questions.explanation: Jacob heard it while his sons were with the livestock in the field, and Jacob held his peace until they came.

answers.text: He went out to fight Shechem
He sent messengers to Hamor
He left the land that night
He held his peace until his sons came

questions.text: What did Hamor propose to Jacob and his sons?
questions.explanation: Hamor said, "Make marriages with us... You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it."

answers.text: To pay a tribute of silver each year
To leave the land within three days
To make marriages and live and trade in the land
To serve Shechem for seven years

questions.text: On what condition did Jacob's sons say they would agree?
questions.explanation: Speaking with deceit, they said they would consent only if every male of them was circumcised as they were.

answers.text: Every male of the city must be circumcised
Shechem must serve seven years for Dinah
The city must give up its gods
Hamor must give them his flocks

questions.text: Where did Hamor and Shechem speak to the men of their city?
questions.explanation: Hamor and Shechem came to the gate of their city and talked with the men of their city.

answers.text: In the open field
In Jacob's tent
At the gate of their city
At the city well

questions.text: Which argument did Hamor and Shechem use with the men of their city?
questions.explanation: They said, "Won't their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours?"

answers.text: Jacob would pay each of them silver
Jacob's livestock would become theirs
Jacob's God would protect their city
Jacob would give them his wells

questions.text: Which two sons of Jacob took their swords and came upon the city?
questions.explanation: On the third day, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.

answers.text: Reuben and Judah
Issachar and Zebulun
Dan and Naphtali
Simeon and Levi

questions.text: Among which peoples did Jacob fear his sons had made him odious?
questions.explanation: Jacob said, "You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites."

answers.text: The Canaanites and the Perizzites
The Philistines and the Egyptians
The Hittites and the Amorites
The Edomites and the Ishmaelites

questions.text: How did Simeon and Levi answer their father?
questions.explanation: They said, "Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?"

answers.text: "We did what you would have wanted."
"Yahweh told us to do this."
"Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?"
"We will return all that we took."
